34825.subject: Physics
34825.question_text: A mass of mass m, experiences a viscous drag, F and an upthrust, U as he descends towards the ground at a steady velocity, Using a parachute. If the acceleration of free fall is g, which of the following expressions is correct?
34825.explanation:
The forces acting on the mass include:

Weight: W = mg (downward)
Upthrust: U (upward)
Viscous Drag: F (upward)

Since the mass is descending at a steady velocity, the net force acting on it is zero. This means that the upward forces (upthrust and viscous drag) balance the downward force (weight): mg = U + F = U + F - mg = 0

34826.subject: Physics
34826.question_text: a body moving at a constant speed accelerates when it is in
34826.explanation: A body moving at a constant speed can accelerate if it is in circular motion. This is because acceleration is a change in velocity, and velocity is a vector quantity, meaning it has both magnitude (speed) and direction. In circular motion, the direction of the velocity is constantly changing, even if the speed is constant, so there is acceleration.
